add.evidence: In 1990, examiners with the state's Department of Business Regulation (DBR) discovered $13 million of fraudulent loans

add.evidence: he fled the state, disappearing on November 8, 1990

add.evidence: The hearings began in July 1991, and were televised.

add.event: 逾500名抗议者聚集州议会大厦，在州长办公室前倾倒茶包
add.evidence: In one event in September 1991, more than 500 chanting protesters gathered at the Statehouse and dumped teabags in front of the Governor's office
